# graviteeam_audits (Data Source)

Reads recent audit logs from a Gravitee AM domain

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graviteeam_audits" "example" {
  domain_id = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  size      = 20
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain to read audits from

### Optional

- `size` (Number) Number of audit entries to retrieve (default: 10)

### Read-Only

- `audits` (String) JSON string containing the audit log entries
